patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background colors are frequently separated by large, organic, wavy shapes, creating soft visual transitions.
Alternating two-column layouts are used for feature descriptions, pairing concise text with relevant illustrations or photographs.
A calming dark green serves as a primary background color, complemented by a lighter accent green for organic separators and a soft off-white for main content areas.
Content blocks and entire sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and upward slide animation as they scroll into the viewport.
Prominent, centered sans-serif headings are used for section titles, establishing clear hierarchy with varying sizes and weights.
The hero section features a card-based navigation system, using friendly, diverse illustrations to represent different user types (Individual, Couples, Teen).

technique_notes: Sections and individual content blocks are revealed with a subtle fade-in and upward slide animation as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic but smooth content flow, likely managed by an Animate On Scroll (AOS) library.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site links and calls to action without changing its visual style.
Background colors transition between sections using large, organic, wave-like shapes that act as visual dividers, adding a soft, natural feel to the page flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with a clear hierarchy, while body text is consistently sized for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and cards, maintaining a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable line spacing for text, creating an open and uncluttered appearance.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, organic, wave-like background shapes to transition between full-width color sections creates a unique visual rhythm and a soft, approachable aesthetic that stands out from typical hard-edged section dividers. This, combined with friendly illustrations and a calming color palette, effectively conveys a sense of empathy and trustworthiness.
